title: Parallel chain bench exports are all removed on disposal
steps: Start Brand and Planner concurrently with deterministic bench doors, write their real exported files, then dispose the chain.
expect: Both exports share the same owned temporary directory.
Both exported directories are absent after disposal; cancellation remains supported.
fence: Remove only the current chain owned scratch directory; preserve explicit evidence retention.

tests: parallel brand and planner exports share one directory and disposal removes both
